newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary farm producer prices down 3.7 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Hungary farm producer prices down 3.7 pct in June.

text.p: Hungary's agricultural producer prices dropped 3.7 percent in June month-on-month and increased 15.6 percent year-on-year, the Central Statistical Office (CSO) said in a statement on Tuesday.
"Taking aside the seasonal drop in fruit and vegetable prices, the (month-on-month) change was minimal," the CSO said.
It added that while potato prices doubled from May to June as new potatoes appeared on the market, fruit prices dropped 47 percent and vegetables were 10 percent cheaper.
Egg prices registered the highest year-on-year price increase of 36.5 percent while fruit prices rose by 25 percent and vegetables by 22 percent, year-on-year.
